candidates.description: This vector activates on Hindi script suffixes and Hindi text tokens alongside variations of the word "artificial".
This vector represents subword tokens and character sequences commonly found in Indic scripts, particularly Hindi/Devanagari text.
This feature vector represents common Hindi suffixes and word fragments ending in nasal or plosive consonants.
This vector represents subword tokens and character fragments from North Indian scripts like Hindi.
These tokens represent fragments and characters from Hindi script.
This vector represents acronyms and abbreviations commonly used in Hindi-language contexts, such as organization names and political entities.
This vector activates for common character sequences and phonemes in Indic and Indo-Aryan languages.
This vector activates for Hindi vowel sign combining characters followed by a comma punctuation mark.
This feature vector activates strongly on Hindi Devanagari vowel sign "i" (ि) and its combinations with various consonants.
These tokens represent common Hindi dependent vowel signs (matras) and consonant-vowel conjuncts frequently occurring in text tokenization.
